**The need**
What are you trying to do? What's missing or awkward today?

**A possible shape**
How might it work? (Rough is fine.)

**Surface**
Which part would it touch? (web app / API / worker / DSP / plugin / desktop)

**Alternatives**
Anything you've considered or worked around.

> For broad direction, members also propose and upvote in the in-app **Board** (`/board`) —
> see [`GOVERNANCE.md`](../../GOVERNANCE.md).
